## **Program Committee Chair**

::: {layout="[[1,3]]"}
![](figs/elan_profile.jpg)

***Elan Segarra***  
Elan (He/Him) is a Research Economist at the Bureau of Labor Statistics in the Compensation Research and Program Development Group. As a representative on the BLS Disclosure Review Board he provides guidance and oversight for agency wide disclosure policy. In addition to improving the use of privacy methods across BLS data products Elan's research interests also include record linkage, measurement error, and synthetic data.
:::
